planning_notes: Board is arduino:avr:uno; PWM output required on D9 as explicitly stated by the requirement (no remapping).
Serial input uses the single supported serial receiver at baud 9600 with framing line_or_idle and idle_timeout_ms=20; no explicit line framing override was provided beyond defaults.
A time base is required for MODE1 LED gradient behavior; elapsed_ms is requested so SysML can implement time-dependent fading using actual delta per control step.
MODE2 constant behavior is represented by driving the same physical LED output (D9) with a steady commanded PWM value; fade timing logic belongs in the model, not in the request.
contract repair: removed unknown field invalid_policy_blank from the pwm_output request; all remaining configuration keys are legal and placed directly on the request object.

interfaces.name: io_0

interfaces.name: io_1

interfaces.name: io_1_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Actual delta since previous control step

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Serial reporting gate for MODE status/telemetry (model-defined)
